## Walkthrough

This pull request refactors the statistics update logic in the accumulate module by replacing a monolithic conditional with three explicit, version-scoped guards. These guards handle different scenarios: pre-0.7.2 behavior when prior activity exists, post-0.7.2 behavior when any activity occurs, and a specific case for Davxy test traces in version 0.7.1. The change consolidates the update condition to trigger if any of the three guards evaluate to true, accompanied by documentation comments explaining each scenario.

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 2 (Simple) | ⏱️ ~10 minutes

- Verify logic equivalence: Ensure the three new guards collectively replicate the previous monolithic condition
- Version comparison accuracy: Confirm version comparisons (< 0.7.2, >= 0.7.2, == 0.7.1) are correct
- Davxy test traces logic: Validate the specific handling for Davxy test suite in version 0.7.1 is properly scoped

## Possibly related PRs

- **FluffyLabs/typeberry#717**: Directly modifies the same file with the same refactoring pattern to replace the monolithic conditional with version-aware guards for per-service statistics updates.
